prompt:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a CANCEL SPARKLE — a small pale-gold four-point star (diamond cross) that flashes out when an enemy bullet is cancelled The palette: pale gold #fff0a0 to white #ffffff cores over gold #d8a018 edges, near-black navy outline — arcade fx palette

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 equal square cells laid out as FOUR cells as TWO rows of TWO (2-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom): the SAME star, square, centred in its cell in the SAME position — ONLY the flash state changes: cell 1 = full bright fat cross-star; cell 2 = thinner, longer rays (white-hot); cell 3 = a short plus of pale light; cell 4 = a single dim dot. This is a continuous one-blast fade: strict monotone from fat star to dot.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 256×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 16 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients on the background, no motion blur.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
label: p-sparkle2 (GEN4 green-key second pass)
